data.title: Customs Ports Record 1,053 Seizures in One Week
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Land, sea, and air customs ports recorded 1,053 seizures of prohibited goods in one week as part of efforts by the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) to combat smuggling and protect society.
    The seizures included 31 types of narcotics, such as hashish, cocaine, heroin, and Captagon pills; 263 other prohibited substances; and 781 cases involving tobacco.
    ZATCA reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening customs oversight of the Kingdom’s imports and exports in coordination with relevant authorities.
    It urged the public to help combat smuggling and protect the national economy by reporting suspicious activities through its security hotline (1910), email (1910@zatca.gov.sa), or international number (009661910). All reports concerning smuggling and violations of the Unified Customs Law are treated as strictly confidential. Financial rewards are also offered for information proven accurate.
    -- SPA
